jobs.title: People Operations & Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  
  
We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  
  
Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

As we scale, we need someone who can keep both our hiring engine and our employee experience running smoothly. This is a hybrid role: roughly half recruiting coordination and half People Operations. You will own interview logistics and the candidate experience on one side, and onboarding, benefits coordination, and core HR administration on the other.

You will be the connective tissue between candidates, new hires, and the teams they join. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and the People team, and you will keep finding ways to make our processes faster and better using AI tools. This is an ideal first or second step into a generalist People career for someone who wants real ownership and exposure to both talent and people operations at a fast-growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Recruiting Coordination (~50%)**

* Own interview scheduling and logistics across multiple concurrent searches, spanning technical and non-technical roles
* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, communicating with a warm, informative tone that makes every touchpoint feel considered
* Coordinate availability across candidates, interviewers, hiring managers, and leadership, including onsite and virtual interviews, panel prep, and debrief scheduling
* Proactively flag scheduling conflicts and pipeline bottlenecks before they become delays
* Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline hygiene in Ashby
* Support offer logistics and hand off new hires to People Ops

**People Operations (~50%)**

* Own end-to-end onboarding for new hires, including pre-employment background checks, new hire paperwork, I-9 verification, travel arrangements, and any other pre-boarding coordination
* Coordinate benefits administration, including new hire enrollment, answering employee benefits questions, and working with brokers and vendors
* Support core HR operations such as maintaining employee records and HRIS data accuracy
* Help prepare employment documentation, such as employment verifications, and status changes, etc in partnership with the People team
* Support employee lifecycle processes including role changes, leaves, and offboarding logistics
* Provide support and contribute to People programs and events such as team onsites, engagement efforts, and new hire welcomes

**Across Both Areas**

* Identify opportunities to use AI tools to streamline scheduling, communication, onboarding, and reporting, and help build and implement those improvements
* Suggest and drive improvements to our recruiting and People processes, especially in ambiguous or undefined situations
* Handle confidential candidate and employee information with care and good judgment

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Experience in Recruiting or People Ops:** 1 - 3 years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator, People Operations Coordinator, HR Coordinator, or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or tech company. Strong internship experience combined with exceptional ownership will also be considered
* **Organized and Detail-Oriented:** Manage many moving pieces, from interview loops to new hire checklists, without dropping details
* **Candidate and Employee-First Mentality:** Treat every interaction, whether with a candidate or a brand-new hire, as a chance to make someone feel supported
* **Strong Written and Verbal Communication:** Write clear, friendly emails that build rapport and keep every stakeholder informed
* **Trustworthy with Sensitive Information:** Understand the importance of confidentiality and use sound judgment when handling personal and employment data
* **AI-Native Working Style:** Use AI tools regularly to streamline your work, and you are excited to find new ways to apply them

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** HBCI Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** HBCI Program Supervisor

**DEPARTMENT**: HBCI (Home Based Crisis Intervention Program)

**JOB TYPE:** Part Time, 21 hours per week

**OBJECTIVES:** Reporting to the HBCI Program Supervisor, the part-time HBCI Coordinator supports the delivery of high-quality, family-centered, home-based crisis intervention services for youth and families by providing clinical supervision, staff support, program oversight, and regulatory compliance monitoring. The HBCI Program Coordinator collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery, adherence to OMH and agency standards, and the achievement of program goals and outcomes while promoting best practices in behavioral health care.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Works closely with the HBCI Program Supervisor to ensure all HBCI program requirements are met.

* Collaborate with the HBCI Program Supervisor in the development and implementation of program goals, objectives, and strategies.

* Supervises Interventionists who provide on-site and crisis-based intervention services to high-risk youth and their families.

* Accompany HBCI staff on initial home visits and provide coverage for visits when staff are unavailable or out of the office.

* Monitors the productivity and performance of HBCI Interventionists to ensure delivery of high-quality services.

* Reviews staff documentation in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to ensure timely, accurate, and complete recordkeeping.

* Ensures compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, including those established by OMH and DOHMH.

* Provides 24-hour on-call coverage for the HBCI program, as assigned.

* Collaborates with the Director of Behavioral Health/Clinic, Assistant Directors, Program Coordinators, Intake Department, and Quality Assurance team to deliver best-practice clinical services in compliance with OMH regulations.

* Attends agency, community, and external meetings and events as required.

* Performs other duties as assigned by the HBCI Program Supervisor and/or the Director of Behavioral Health.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS**:

* Knowledge and experience utilizing evidence-based treatment models and interventions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships.
* Ability to present program services and information to community organizations and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated cultural competence, humility, and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* LMSW/ LCSW or LMHC with a current New York State License.
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with children, adolescents, or young adults experiencing acute mental health crises.
* Experience providing services to youth and families impacted by behavioral health challenges.
* Experience delivering home-based services and willingness to travel to clients’ homes.
* Experience providing clinical supervision to staff, SIFI training preferred.
* Bilingual Spanish-speaking skills preferred.

**COMPENSATION: $35 per hour, 21 hours per week**

**About Northside**

Northside Center for Child Development serves more than 5,500 children and families across New York City each year through high-quality, outcome-driven behavioral health, early childhood education, and enrichment services. With over $34 million in annual funding, Northside provides the comprehensive support children and families need to overcome adversity, build resilience, and pursue their dreams.

Founded in 1946 in Harlem, Northside has been a cornerstone of the community for eight decades, leading the way in integrating education and mental health to support children’s development. Several of Northside’s innovative programs were the first of their kind in Harlem, setting standards of care that continue to influence social service agencies throughout the United States today.

Northside’s founders, Drs. Kenneth B. and Mamie Phipps Clark, were renowned, pioneering psychologists whose groundbreaking research was instrumental in the 1954 Brown v. Board of Education landmark Supreme Court decision that declared school segregation unconstitutional. Their belief in the worth, dignity, and potential of every child continues to guide Northside’s mission and inspire its work today. Northside is driven by its vision and principle, “Each Child…First Chance.”

For more information on Northside Center for Child Development, please visit www.northsidecenter.org.

**We're Hiring: Digital Marketing Coordinator**
===============================================

**American Arbitration Association (AAA)**

### **Help Us Create Better Digital Experiences**

Are you a detail-oriented digital marketer who enjoys working with websites, marketing technology, and data? Do you love bringing campaigns to life, solving problems, and finding ways to improve the online customer experience?

  
  

The **American Arbitration Association (AAA)** is looking for a **Digital Marketing Coordinator** to join our Marketing team!

In this hands-on role, you'll help manage and optimize our digital presence, support integrated marketing campaigns, and ensure our websites, landing pages, and lead-generation experiences are engaging, effective, and easy to navigate.

This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career marketing professional who enjoys combining creativity, technology, and analytics to make a measurable impact.

  
  

### **What You'll Do**

**Manage and Enhance Our Digital Presence**

* Create, update, and maintain website pages, landing pages, forms, and digital content using our content management system (CMS).
* Support website improvements, SEO best practices, and user experience enhancements.
* Test and troubleshoot website content, links, and forms to ensure a seamless digital experience.

**Bring Digital Campaigns to Life**

* Support the execution of email, social media, paid media, event, and lead-generation campaigns.
* Collaborate with marketing, creative, and technical teams to launch digital assets accurately and on schedule.
* Help implement campaign tracking and measurement tools.

**Support Marketing Technology and Lead Generation**

* Build and maintain lead-capture forms, registrations, and conversion experiences.
* Help ensure marketing leads and campaign data flow accurately into our marketing platforms and CRM systems, including Salesforce.
* Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes and digital workflows.

**Measure, Learn, and Optimize**

* Monitor website traffic, engagement, conversions, and campaign performance.
* Use analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support A/B testing and optimization initiatives to improve digital marketing results.
  

  

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, digital media, or a related field, plus 1–3 years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Working knowledge of Google Analytics or similar analytics platforms.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* Experience with Umbraco, PushPlanet, or Digioh.
* Exposure to Salesforce or marketing automation platforms.
* Familiarity with SEO, conversion optimization, or A/B testing.
  

  

### **Why Join AAA?**

At the American Arbitration Association, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful marketing initiatives while expanding your skills across website management, digital campaigns, analytics, and marketing technology.

  
  

You'll collaborate with colleagues across marketing and technology, gain hands-on experience with digital platforms, and help improve how customers discover and engage with AAA's services.

  
  

If you're organized, tech-savvy, analytical, and excited to grow your digital marketing career, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location: Secaucus, NJ

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Dotted-Line Coordination: Creative Director of Marketing, Brand Editor, and Social Media Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt), overtime-eligible

Compensation: $26–$31 per hour

Artistic Tile is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our Marketing Department while building real event and design skills along the way. This is a high-growth role: reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll get exposure to every part of the department — email, website, product literature, social, PR, and events — and the chance to take on more as you show what you can do.

Your core work is events, followed by design. You'll help plan and run the showroom events and trade shows that put our brand in front of customers and dealers, and you'll use tools like Canva and AI-assisted design to produce the collateral, labels, and presentations that support our sales and marketing efforts.

About Artistic Tile

Artistic Tile is a family-owned and operated luxury tile and stone company—design, import, distribution, and retail under one roof. We're leaders in our field because of the value we place on design innovation, quality control, and customer service. You'll join a marketing team known for producing content that sets the standard for the industry. Our reputation is established; your job is to help create the work and the experiences that uphold it.

What You'll Do

* Event Concept & Production: Help plan and execute showroom events and trade shows, coordinating the invitations, signage, and on-site branding (working with the Creative Director and design team on the look) along with venue selection, catering, rentals, and vendor coordination, for both in-person and virtual events.
* On-Site Event Presence: Represent the brand in person at events, making real-time calls on setup, signage placement, and presentation so the space matches the approved brand look and event plan.
* Design & Collateral Production: Using Canva and AI-assisted design tools, design swatch cards, recess tray labels, product literature layouts, internal presentation templates, social graphics, and other brand collateral — owning each piece from first draft through final, print-ready file. You'll work within the brand templates and standards set by the Creative Director of Marketing, and extend them to new needs.
* AI-Assisted Workflow & Accuracy: Use AI tools to speed up layout, reformatting, and first drafts, and review all output for brand fit and for accuracy against product data (SKUs, dimensions, finish names, ratings) before anything is routed for approval or printed.
* Marketing Department Support: Support the full marketing team day to day, helping the Marketing Manager and teammates across email, website, product literature, social, and PR projects; organizing and distributing promotional materials to showrooms, dealers, and partners; and keeping project tasks and timelines current in Basecamp.
* Brand Stewardship: Work with external vendors and agencies to keep design and messaging consistent and high-quality across every channel.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product development, and design to keep marketing materials aligned, accurate, and on-brand.

What We're Looking For

* At least 1 year of related experience in event coordination, marketing, or design.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, design, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Experience or strong interest in event logistics and vendor coordination — venues, catering, rentals — and in the on-site energy of a live event.
* Strong time and project management skills, with a knack for prioritizing and hitting deadlines, especially under the pressure of a live event date.
* Fluency in Canva, including building and maintaining templates and brand kits.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude) in design or content work, and the judgment to review their output critically.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can tailor a message clearly for different audiences.
* Comfort working autonomously: you can self-direct your daily tasks and take ownership of a project from concept to completion.
* A collaborative spirit and openness to feedback.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel occasionally and work some evenings/weekends around event dates (all hours worked are paid, with overtime per company policy and applicable law).

Bonus Points

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
* Experience with NetSuite, CRM software, or Basecamp.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing platforms or website content management.

Why You'll Want This Role

* Events with visible impact: You'll help create the showroom events and trade show experiences that customers, designers, and dealers remember — and see how the brand shows up in person.
* Modern tools: We're building our design workflow around Canva and AI-assisted tools, so you'll grow skills that are in demand.
* A high-growth role: This is a launchpad. Demonstrate your skills and there's a clear path to take on greater creative and strategic responsibility as the department grows.
* Exposure to the whole department: Working under the Marketing Manager, you'll see how email, web, print, PR, and events fit together — a fast way to learn the business and find where you want to specialize.
* A great location: A modern headquarters in Secaucus with an easy commute from Manhattan and throughout North New Jersey.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
*Please Note: This role requires the ability to work on site 3 days per*

*week per company policy.*

The annual salary range for this role in New York is $105,000-$120,000.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

**Why we are recruiting**

As a partnership organization and through the Business Engagement teams, the World Economic Forum engages the private sector to address industry, regional and systemic issues. Partners benefit from and contribute to the global knowledge base through working closely with the Forum to set the intellectual agenda of Forum gatherings, drive the insight agenda of its publications and steer the impact of its initiatives.

Structured geographically, the Global Industries Team is responsible for building and managing the world’s premier communities of business executives.

We are currently seeking an Account Manager (internal title Senior Account Associate, Communication and Technology Industries), who will be tasked to manage a portfolio of Partner accounts and engage relevant executives in the Forum’s events, initiatives and communities. The role will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned organizations; develop and implement tailored engagement strategies plans that strengthen relationships with CEOs and C-suite executives and identify opportunities to strengthen the engagement with the Forum.

  

The portfolio is primarily composed of high-growth companies shaping the next generation of technology, business models, and critical infrastructure, and are increasingly looking to engage with global business, government, and civil society leaders on issues of systemic importance.

**Reporting Lines and Interactions**

The role will interact with our partners, and across multiple teams ranging from Finance, Contract Management to Industry, Centre and Government engagement groups. The person will report to the Senior Manager, Communications and Technology.

**Main** **responsibilities**

* **Partner relationship management**: Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Partner representatives; lead regular engagement with Partners to understand their strategic priorities; collaborate with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless Partner experience. Engage partners in relevant industry work.
* **Portfolio growth and account management**: Monitor Partner engagement, business developments and overall account health to identify opportunities for partnership growth and expansion; proactively identify partnership risks and develop retention strategies in collaboration with the Head of Industry to maximize long-term Partner value.
* **Partner engagement and event strategy:** Develop tailored engagement plans strategies for Partners; shape executive agendas identify relevant opportunities for executive participation, speaking roles and leadership interactions and ensure effective follow-up to maximize engagement outcomes.
* **Cross-functional collaboration**: Work closely with Industry, Regional, Centre, Event, Finance and Partner Development teams to coordinate Partner activities; provide strategic guidance to Account Associates on operational delivery and ensure high-quality execution across the Partner lifecycle.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* **Partner engagement**: Strong and trusted relationships with senior executives, reflected in sustained engagement across Forum activities.
* **Partner retention**: High retention rates and proactive management of at-risk accounts through effective engagement strategies.
* **Cross-functional delivery Collaboration and leadership**: Effective coordination across internal teams, enabling a seamless Partner experience and consistent knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Requirements and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Economics, Management or another relevant field.
* Knowledge and understanding of the business and political landscape of Communications and Technology companies.
* 4+ years of full-time experience in a business development or relationship management role in a fast-changing professional environment. Working knowledge and experience of sales cycle management, account management, market research is a must.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationship with partners that enable the Forum to drive new business opportunities
* Excellent organizational, project and time management skills, a strong work ethic, and high attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and manage expectations of senior stakeholders
* Agile team player who enjoys working in a highly collaborative, culturally diverse, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.
* Deep passion for the future of the business in the emerging world, the role it plays within the global context, and its potential impact on society and the individual
* Responsible, independent, and self-driven with a learning mindset and a positive attitude
* Proficient in working with MS Office and Salesforce, experience with other CRM tools a plus.
* Proficiency in working with AI solutions – knowledge of Chat GPT and Slack a plus.

**Why join us?**

Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

jobs.title: Associate Account Executive/Sales Operations
jobs.description:
About Us:

Inspiring brand “Collectors” since 2001, Robert Graham is well known for offering #WearableArt that makes a statement. Centered around our motto, **“Be the Shout, Not the Echo”**, our Collectors can *tune up or down the color and details, for a custom expression of their individual style.*

Robert Graham is at the forefront of design innovation defined by expert craftsmanship and exquisite attention-to-detail including intricately mixed fabrics, trims, embroidery, and one-of-a-kind original prints.

With a full head-to-toe wardrobe in mind, we push ourselves to redefine menswear across button downs, blazers, graphic t-shirts, premium denim, leather goods and more. We also continue to expand our Women’s Collection by chic tops, dresses, jackets, accessories and more.

Come see what’s in store or, learn more at Robertgraham.us and @robertgrahamnyc

**Sales**

Our sales professionals have a major impact on our business as they develop and implement the projections, forecasts and long-range planning strategies that will fuel our success today and into the future. A career in sales puts you alongside talented people working cross-functionally throughout our organization. The challenges are exciting, the pace is fast, and you’ll have a chance to build a career of almost limitless possibilities.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include::

The **Associate Account Executive/Sales Operations** will support the Robert Graham Wholesale business by managing customer service, account setup, order fulfillment, shipping communication, NuOrder, and day-to-day sales administration. This role will serve as a key liaison between key and specialty accounts, the sales team, distribution, credit, planning, and other internal partners to help ensure accounts are properly onboarded, orders are processed accurately, and shipments are completed on time.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple accounts, reps and priorities in a fast-paced wholesale environment. This position will play an important role in providing a high level of service to our customers while improving visibility, follow-through, and operational efficiency across the business.

**Customer Service and Order Management**

* Serve as the primary operational contact for Specialty Store accounts regarding order status, shipping, inventory availability, and delivery questions.
* Manage orders from entry through shipment, ensuring accuracy across styles, quantities, pricing, discounts, terms, shipping windows, and customer requirements.
* Monitor open orders and proactively communicate potential shipping delays, inventory shortages, credit holds, or other issues.
* Provide customers and sales representatives with shipment confirmations, tracking information, invoices, and order-status updates.
* Process order revisions, cancellations, extensions, substitutions, and other customer requests.
* Coordinate returns, return authorizations, shortages, damages, chargebacks, and shipping claims as needed.
* Maintain customer-specific compliance requirements.

**Account Setup and Maintenance**

* Manage the setup and onboarding of new accounts from initial request through account activation.
* Collect and review credit applications, resale certificates, payment information, shipping instructions, routing requirements, and other required documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit, Finance, Customer Service, and other internal teams to ensure accounts are approved, activated and maintained promptly.
* Maintain accurate customer records, contact information, payment terms, shipping instructions, sales representative assignments, and account notes.
* Communicate account-setup status, outstanding requirements, and approvals to customers and the sales team.
* Support updates to existing accounts, including ownership, billing, shipping, contact, and credit-information changes.

**NuOrder Management**

* Manage the day-to-day administration of NuOrder for the wholesale business.
* Set up and maintain customer and sales representative access, account assignments, territories, and permissions.
* Review NuOrder orders for accuracy and coordinate their entry or integration into the order-management system.
* Troubleshoot customer and sales representative questions related to login access, product visibility, order placement, and platform functionality.
* Monitor NuOrder activity and follow up on incomplete orders, draft orders, and other sales opportunities.
* Ensure product, pricing, inventory, and account information remain accurate and current within the platform.
* Coordinate with internal teams and NuOrder support to resolve platform or integration issues.

**Specialty Sales Support**

* Provide day-to-day back-office support for the Specialty Stores sales team and outside sales representatives.
* Submit, review, and maintain wholesale orders in the order-management system.
* Prepare order confirmations, open-order reports, shipping recaps, ATS reports, and other sales materials.
* Help manage order deadlines, shipping windows, and follow-up calendars.
* Coordinate sample and collateral requests for specialty accounts and sales representatives.

**Reporting and Business Coordination**

* Maintain regular reporting on bookings, open orders, shipments, cancellations, returns, and account status.
* Identify order or shipping issues that could affect revenue and escalate them to sales leadership.
* Track specialty-account performance and provide information needed for sales recaps and business reviews.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Allocation, Credit, Finance, Production, Distribution, and Customer Service.
* Support the development and improvement of sales-operation processes, reporting tools, and account-service standards.
* Complete additional sales administration projects as needed.

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have::

* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, wholesale cust

jobs.title: Account Manager (Advertising)
jobs.description:
**THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide. Our brands and properties group partners with iconic brands and rights holders to turn relevance into revenue through integrated strategy and consulting, creative, live experiences and commercialization. We help clients understand, connect to and inspire global audiences by bringing together brands, properties and talent/creators to build meaningful relationships that drive measurable business outcomes.**

  

**Shaped by our belief in the unifying power of sports, music and entertainment, THE·TEAM leads with intelligence, ideas and influence. For more information, please visit** **the.team** **.**

  
  

**\*\* Must have advertising agency experience \*\***

**Job Overview:**

  

We are seeking a dedicated Account Manager to join our team and manage our relationship with a sports focused brand. If you’re a meticulous task manager, a natural-born leader, obsessive about creating exciting work, and adept at forming and strengthening bonds with various personalities, we want to hear from you.

  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Manage, maintain, and grow relationships with the client and key stakeholders
* Set priorities, organize work streams, and assume a leadership role for assigned projects
* Act as the glue that holds internal teams together, delegate work when necessary, and help define the brand vision alongside creative, strategy, and other teams
* Manage projects and creative timelines with the client, working closely with Project Managers to adhere to campaign schedules
* Influence the development of the highest-quality creative work by sharing knowledge of the client, business, and brand, while demonstrating strong creative judgment and providing strategic recommendations
* Act as a leader of the integrated marketing team, ensuring partnership and collaboration between THE·TEAM and other agencies
Attend on-site activations and manage client relationships on-site when required  

  

**What We're Looking For:**

  

* 2-3 years experience in an account role or related role **in an advertising agency or marketing agency**
* Experience in implementing culturally relevant social media campaigns
* Ability to develop detailed plans and lead team meetings, identify and resolve issues and manage risk
* Detail-focused with strong communication skills: persuasive, strategic, proactive, diplomatic
* Ability to forge strong relationships with clients as well as internal stakeholders
* A demonstrated passion for and superb understanding of the social media landscape
Commitment to excellence — working nonstandard hours when necessary, anticipating issues and communicating with diplomacy, identifying emerging platforms and trends to drive innovation.  

  

**What We Offer**

* **Professional Development** : Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support.
* **Generous Time Off** : Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones.
* **Parental Leave** : We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events.
* **Retirement Plan** : 401k plan including contribution matching.
* **Healthcare** : Medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life and disability coverage options.
* **Ancillary** : Critical illness, identity protection, pet insurance, 529 plans and more
* **Commuter Benefits** : Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available

  

Base salary range: $70,000 - $85,000 plus bonus potential.

Actual base salary is dependent on several factors including but not limited to; market dynamics, location and region, experience, specialized skills/training (education), level of responsibility, budgetary considerations, tenure at the company (for current employees), etc. The salary range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Compensation decisions are dependent on circumstances of each hire.

*THE·TEAM does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.*

jobs.title: Email Operations Specialist

The Email Operations Specialist will be responsible for the day-to-day, hands-on execution of marketing campaign emails and for supporting our triggered lifecycle flows. This role is critical to the operational success of our email program, owning the setup and delivery of campaign sends. The ideal candidate is eager to dive in and learn, wants to push the envelope on technical email production, and is excited about creating personalized digital experiences at scale.

This role sits on the Growth Marketing team and reports to the Director, Lifecycle Marketing, working out of our NYC office 2x a week.

**What you'll do here**

* Execute day-to-day email campaign operations: prep image assets, code templates, build and segment lists, schedule sends, and set up tests
* Build responsive, personalized triggered email templates and support triggered flow setup in Sailthru
* Own QA of every send across devices, email clients, and environments
* Troubleshoot rendering and technical issues, including HTML templates, broken links, and list segmentation
* Explore and apply AI tools to work more efficiently across email operations
* Leverage ESP tools and Sailthru's scripting language (Zephyr) to deliver dynamic content
* Manage audience lists and maintain list hygiene through data cleansing to improve targeting accuracy
* Analyze campaign performance and contribute test and optimization ideas to inform future campaigns
* Partner with the team on campaign planning, bringing a technical and data-informed perspective

**Requirements**

* 2–4 years of proven experience in email marketing, including hands-on work in an ESP (Sailthru preferred)
* HTML/CSS email coding experience, including working with ESP scripting or templating languages (Zephyr preferred)
* Experience QA'ing emails across devices and email clients
* Experience with email testing tools (Litmus preferred)
* Strong understanding of email marketing best practices
* Knowledge of relevant email marketing regulations (CAN-SPAM, GDPR)
* Experience with marketing automation and personalization software and tools
* Proficiency in at least one customer data platform and data visualization tool (Looker preferred)
* Analytical mindset; comfortable using performance data to inform recommendations
* Strong technical proficiency; comfortable learning new systems

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Outbound (Hybrid - NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in New York City, NY)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.

Qualifications**  Proven success in healthcare sales, business development, or medical services sales. **Demonstrated ability to independently source, develop, and close new business.**  Established relationships with surgeons, procedural specialists, physician-owners, or surgical practice leadership. **Strong prospecting, networking, negotiation, and consultative selling skills. Preferred Experience**  Direct sales experience in IDR, state arbitration, out-of-network claims, or healthcare revenue recovery. **Medical billing, revenue cycle management (RCM), denial management, or reimbursement services sold to surgical practices.**  Medical device, surgical implant, surgical technology, or other healthcare sales involving direct relationships with surgeons. **Experience selling to specialties such as orthopedics, spine, neurosurgery, neuromonitoring, interventional pain management, podiatry, ENT, gastroenterology, urology, plastic surgery, and vascular surgery.**  A track record of personally originating and closing new physician or practice accounts. Experience selling to general medical practices without meaningful relationships in surgical or procedural specialties is less relevant to this position. Compensation and Employment Options Full-Time Sales Position: Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, with compensation tailored to experience, established relationships, and demonstrated sales production. Independent Sales Contractor: Commission-based opportunities may be available for established sales professionals with strong provider relationships and the ability to generate business independently. These arrangements are particularly suited to candidates with established networks in markets outside the New York area. Location and Travel Redbird's immediate priority is to hire at least one sales professional who can work in person at its Brooklyn, New York corporate office. Additional opportunities may be available to qualified candidates in other states who can demonstrate meaningful business potential within their territories, strong relationships with procedural specialists, and the ability to develop and close new accounts. jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Coordinator supports locations across the Endurant Disaster Recovery network, keeping restoration and reconstruction jobs organized, documented, and moving from estimate approval through final payment. This role manages job setup, contracts, invoicing, third-party administrator (TPA) compliance, and job status reporting under the direction of the Project Coordinator Manager, in partnership with location Estimators, Project Managers, and the VP of Construction.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple jobs, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. This person serves as a key link between corporate, field operations, estimating, customers, carriers, and trade partners, and helps bring consistent coordination practices to every location.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Job Setup and Documentation**

* Enter and maintain accurate job information, project dates, and weekly progress notes in the job management systems (RM, PSA) and corresponding TPA platforms
* Confirm jobs are approved for production and that all claim information, including the deductible, has been collected
* Collect and file required job documents, including authorizations to repair (ATRs), contracts, change orders, certificates of completion (COCs), TPA-required documents, and lien waivers
* Send work authorizations, contracts, change orders, and punch lists to customers through DocuSign, and track signatures to completion
* Request EagleView reports and other supporting documentation as needed
* Compile and file the completed supervisor estimate and supporting paperwork at job close

**Contracts, Budgeting, and Scheduling**

* Prepare contracts with clear payment schedules after estimate approval, in coordination with the Estimator
* Import estimates into PSA when needed and review work orders and job budgets against company targets
* Issue subcontracts and work orders to trade partners as directed by Project Managers, with purchase orders in place before work is released
* Build job schedules and coordinate changes with Project Managers
* Coordinate temporary assignments as needed
* Support Project Managers and Estimators in following the company change order policy, including signed change orders and collected deposits before work begins

**Invoicing and Collections**

* Match trade and supplier invoices to purchase orders and flag discrepancies
* Route invoices to Project Managers for approval and prepare customer invoices for delivery by the Estimator
* Monitor payment schedules and follow up to keep collections aligned with contract terms
* Escalate to the Project Coordinator Manager any job that starts without a collected deductible, deposit, or approved draw schedule, or whose outstanding collections exceed company thresholds

**TPA and Carrier Compliance**

* Monitor TPA platforms daily, including Contractor Connection, Westhill, and Sedgwick
* Maintain compliance with TPA guidelines, complete required uploads, and support strong performance rankings
* Upload, label, and organize job photos in TPA portals
* Follow up with adjusters on estimate approvals and supplements at the Estimator's request
* Support Estimators in communication with customers, agents, adjusters, and TPAs

**Job Tracking and Reporting**

* Attend weekly job review meetings and bi-weekly work-in-progress (WIP) meetings with the VP of Construction, Estimators, and Project Managers, and follow through on action items
* Track each job's status (Received, Scoped, Pending, Sold, WIP, Completed) and escalate jobs that stall to the Project Coordinator Manager
* Prepare and share weekly job status reports with the Project Coordinator Manager, Project Managers, and the VP of Construction
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Multi-Location Support**

* Support project coordination for locations across the Endurant network, including subsidiary companies and newly acquired locations
* Provide coverage for location coordinators during peak volume, staffing gaps, or catastrophe (CAT) events
* Promote consistent job documentation, contract, invoicing, and TPA compliance standards across locations
* Assist with onboarding new locations to company systems and coordination processes

**Performance Measures**

* TPA compliance and performance scores
* Timeliness of weekly job status updates
* Accuracy of contracts and invoices
* Turnaround time on contract and invoice creation and follow-up
* Number of delayed or on-hold jobs

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* 2+ years of experience in project coordination, construction administration, or a related office role
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple jobs and deadlines at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with customers, adjusters, and trade partners
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning job management and e-signature platforms

**Preferred**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, construction management, or a related field
* Experience in property restoration, insurance claims, or construction
* Familiarity with Xactimate, PSA, RM, DocuSign, or TPA platforms such as Contractor Connection, Westhill, or Sedgwick
* Working knowledge of invoicing, purchase orders, and collections

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
-----------------------------------------

* Hybrid work environment, with extended periods of sitting and computer use
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds
* Less than 5% travel to supporting locations and job sites as needed
* May require extended hours during high-volume periods or catastrophe (CAT) events

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola owns every layer of insurance, from pricing with weather data to paying claims, and thousands of independent agents now trust us to protect their clients' homes. Almost all of those agencies found us through word of mouth, and as we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, the agencies that already sell Sola are the heart of our business. We're looking for an Account Manager who will treat a book of those agencies as their own, help them win more with Sola every month, and show our newer teammates what great partnership looks like.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR**
---------

* **Role:** Account Manager
* **Level:** Mid-level individual contributor, one step above Associate Account Manager
* **Key focus:** Owning and growing a book of independent agency partners
* **Location:** West Midtown, Atlanta, GA

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to own a book of active independent agency partners and grow what they write with Sola. The job is to become the person each of your agencies calls first, keep Sola part of their everyday sales conversations, and turn quiet agencies into consistent producers.

You are someone who has already owned a set of accounts or partners on your own, who measures your work by retention and growth, and who enjoys being both a trusted advisor and a problem solver. This is not a traditional service desk role where you wait for tickets, and it is not a hunting role focused on signing new agencies, since our Territory Sales Managers bring partners in and you help them thrive.

You should constantly be:

* Checking in with your agencies by phone, video and in person so they feel confident quoting Sola
* Spotting which agencies are slowing down and acting before they go quiet
* Training agents on our product, tools and process so selling Sola feels easy
* Solving escalations quickly with our underwriting, claims and product teams
* Bringing what you hear from agencies back to the team so we keep improving

You'll work closely with the rest of Account Management, our Territory Sales Managers and our product team, and you'll help build the playbook that the next wave of Associate Account Managers learns from.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* A defined book of active independent agencies and their retention with Sola
* Growth in quotes and policies written across your book
* A regular cadence of check-ins, reviews and agency visits
* Agent training on Sola's product, quoting tools and process
* Fast, complete resolution of agency escalations across teams
* Clean CRM records and a clear view of the health of every account
* Agency feedback shared with product and leadership
* Day-to-day coaching for Associate Account Managers who shadow your work

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

### **Must-haves**

* Experience owning a book of accounts or partners yourself in account management, customer success or a partner-facing role, typically two to four years
* Real results in retaining and growing accounts that you can walk us through with numbers
* A steady, self-driven cadence for check-ins, follow-ups and escalations
* Strong CRM habits and the instinct to use data to decide where to spend your time
* Clear, warm communication with business owners on the phone, in writing and in person
* Curiosity, coachability and low ego, with a habit of asking why
* Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest problem solving and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.

### **Strong plus**

* Experience working with independent insurance agents, brokers or another reseller channel
* Time at an early-stage startup where you helped build the process
* Experience training customers or coaching junior teammates
* Comfort using dashboards, simple analysis or AI tools to manage a book

### **Not a fit**

* You prefer a support role where someone else owns the relationship and the growth goal
* You want a pure new business hunting role
* You need a fully built playbook before you can perform
* You are looking for a remote or hybrid schedule

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Stock options, so you share in what you help build
* 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
* Unlimited PTO
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office
* Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday

**Our Values**
--------------

* **We are a team of owners.** Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.
* **The best idea always wins.** We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.
* **Always raise the bar.** Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.
* **Customer and partner driven.** Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.
* **Results focused.** We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.
* **Ask why, stay curious.** Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

As one of the fastest-growing on-the-go drinkware companies in America, we’ve got a reputation for doing great things. Our vision is simple - bring delight to eating and drinking.

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

We believe the right way to design products starts and ends with two key ingredients: process + people. Process is the path that takes us from ideas to products that are on brand, on time and on budget. People are the secret sauce that adds ingenuity every step of the way.

Together, we navigate each day with optimism, curiosity, a healthy sense of humor and a strong allergy to the word “no.” This desire for better, coupled with a deep understanding of consumers’ daily lives, gets us to meaningful delight.

**About the Role**

The Project Management Coordinator is an entry-level position within the Project Management Office (PMO) primarily responsible for coordinating and overseeing a portfolio of Renovation projects while providing administrative and operational support to the broader PMO team. The Project Management Coordinator will work closely with cross-functional partners to establish project timelines, track deliverables, communicate project status, identify risks or delays, and ensure projects progress according to established deadlines. This position will support key PMO processes and administrative activities as needed. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their project management career who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and interested in developing cross-functional project management experience within a consumer products environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate and manage assigned Renovation projects from initial project intake through completion. These projects will include but are not limited to seasonal retailer endcap or display programs, new inline color refreshes, and/or multipack packaging development.
* Serve as the primary project management point of contact for assigned Renovation projects, ensuring cross-functional partners understand project scope, responsibilities, and deadlines.
* Develop and maintain project timelines using SmartSheet, Basecamp, and other PMO tools.
* Facilitate project communication and provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders regarding project status, upcoming milestones, risks, and outstanding actions.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential schedule risks, missing information, or outstanding decisions.
* Escalate issues and missed deadlines to the appropriate project stakeholders and PMO leadership when necessary.

* Manage the administrative intake process for new Renovation projects submitted through the Renovation Intake Form.
* Maintain PMIS trackers and ensure project information remains accurate and current.
* Support the preparation and coordination of quarterly PMO Lessons Learned meetings, including assisting in the preparation, organizing information, documenting key learnings during the meeting, and helping track follow-up actions.
* Assist with other PMO process improvement and administrative initiatives as assigned.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Supply Chain, Marketing, Operations, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 1+ years of professional experience, including internships, project coordination, or other relevant experience.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to proactively follow up with stakeholders and drive tasks toward completion.
* Thrives working in a cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to identify when information, decisions, or deliverables are missing and take appropriate action.
* Logical and creative problem-solving and analytical skills required.
* Possesses influencing skills (leads by example, clearly articulates business cases and interpretation of cause-effect impact).
* Experience with project management tools such as SmartSheet, Basecamp or similar platforms preferred but not required
* Experience working in a consumer products, retail, or customer-focused environment preferred but not required

**Benefits at Leapfrog**

* 15 days Paid Time Off your first year, and an additional day each year thereafter (up to 25 days), as well as company paid sick days, holidays and parental leave options
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as commuter benefits and additional voluntary benefits
* Annual bonus payouts for all salaried employees, and up to a 5% 401k match with no vesting period
* Summer Fridays - from Memorial Day to Labor Day enjoy half days every Friday

Learn more about life at Leapfrog and our benefits by visiting us at www.leapfrogbrands.com

Leapfrog is currently operating under a hybrid work model, and this position will report on site to our Lincoln Park office at least 2 days per week. Additional ad-hoc in office days may be required based on business needs. Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with a hybrid work model.

**Salary Band**

jobs.description:
Production Artist & Print Project Coordinator

Riverside Graphics and Lowitz + Sons are established Chicago printing companies providing digital printing, commercial printing, design, and print production management services. We handle everything from everyday business printing to more complex publications, marketing materials, and specialty print projects.

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented person with practical layout, typesetting, and prepress skills to support our customer service and production teams.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on position combining basic layout and typesetting, preflight and file preparation, order processing, and print project coordination.

Initially, the role will primarily support our existing customer service representatives and project managers behind the scenes, helping prepare files, process orders, develop estimates, and coordinate production. As you become familiar with our customers and processes, the goal is to take on greater responsibility for managing projects and providing direct customer support.

We're looking for someone who understands how printing works, enjoys solving problems, and is comfortable handling a variety of responsibilities in a small business environment.

Responsibilities

**Graphics & Prepress**

* Prepare, review, and modify customer artwork for print production.
* Create and revise layouts for brochures, booklets, business cards, presentations, and other printed materials.
* Preflight files, identify potential printing issues, and make necessary corrections.
* Prepare print-ready PDFs, proofs, and production files for digital and commercial printing.
* Work with our production team and outside vendors to ensure files are prepared correctly.

**Order Processing & Project Coordination**

* Assist customer service representatives and project managers with preparing estimates, writing orders, and coordinating jobs.
* Review project specifications and identify missing information or potential production issues.
* Request pricing and coordinate production details with outside printing and finishing vendors.
* Track job progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help keep projects moving through production.
* Support both Riverside Graphics' in-house printing operations and Lowitz + Sons' commercial print projects.
* Develop the ability to communicate directly with customers and fully manage assigned projects.

**Production Support**

* When needed, assist the production team with basic hand assembly, finishing, packaging, and shipping.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat.
* Experience preparing artwork and files for commercial printing.
* Working knowledge of bleeds, trim sizes, resolution, color modes, and other print production requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* Comfortable working independently, recognizing problems, and asking questions when needed.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to work collaboratively with customer service, production staff, and outside vendors.

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Previous experience working for a commercial printer, quick-print shop, or print production company.
* Experience with print estimating, job tickets, or print management software.
* Familiarity with digital printing equipment and basic bindery operations.
* Experience communicating with customers or coordinating print projects.

**What We're Looking For**

The right candidate is someone who combines practical design and technical production skills with good organization and follow-through.

We value accuracy, reliability, flexibility, and a willingness to learn. You should enjoy working on a variety of projects and be comfortable in an environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

This is a good opportunity for someone with graphic design or prepress experience who wants to expand into print production coordination and project management.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Pay: 29.95/hour**

**What you can expect:**

The Clinical Research Coordinator position is responsible for supporting clinical research staff and managing new and ongoing clinical research activities. The position includes assisting clinical investigators and research staff to drive projects forward by interacting closely with external clinical research organizations and sponsors.

Preparation of all study documentation such as protocols, amendments, case report forms, SAE reports, and study reports is an integral part of this job. The Clinical Research Coordinator will adhere to GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines in the conduct of all study-related activities.

**How you will make an impact:**

* Provide study coordination for assigned trials as directed by the Clinical Research Manager; including data coordination and quality control of research data.
* Provide back-up and support for all areas of clinical research
* Complete regulatory paperwork for IRB submissions, annual reviews and study close-out
* Ensure that all Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) are reported in a timely fashion to IRB and sponsor
* Create and update Regulatory Binder for each assigned study
* Assist with monitoring visits
* Interact/liaise with study sponsors and investigators in role of study representative
* Conduct eligibility screening interviews over the phone and/or in person
* Schedule study patient appointments and make reminder calls to patients; send reminder letters and emails as appropriate
* Conduct study patient visits per protocol, including screening and follow-up visits, data collection and entry, specimen collection, and other study activities
* Communicate clinical trial status to management and staff through meetings and tracking system; maintain related records
* Create and update paper and electronic study patient records
* Participate in other recruitment/retention activities as needed, including calling potential participants and occasional outreach
* Attend trainings, staff meetings, and in-services as required
* Assist lab personnel with specimen processing and shipping as needed
* May be asked to attend Investigator Meetings for new trials as assigned

**What you will bring to Howard Brown Health:**

**QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, & SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* B.S. or B.A. & 2 years+ clinical research experience
* A.A. or A.S. & 5 years+ clinical research experience
* High School Diploma/Equivalent & 8 years+ clinical research experience
* Strong writing skills and the ability to write clearly
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Strong attention to detail, ability to take initiative
* Possess the ability to prioritize while multi-tasking in a team setting or alone
* Working knowledge of general medical terminology
* Working knowledge industry regulations, standards and guidance
* Effectively communicate with physicians, nurses, pharmaceutical companies and other team members.

**Preferred:**

* B.S. Degree in Health Care Field or Life Science
* Certified Clinical Research Coordinator
