jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support
jobs.description:
Salary range is:

$94,890.40 - $130,000.00

This position is bonus and/or commission eligible.

CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

**The Role**
============

The Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support is a senior technical, customer-facing individual contributor responsible for supporting the reliability and operational health of CCC’s enterprise customers. The role focuses primarily on strategic automotive accounts with the most complex technical environments and support needs, while also providing technical expertise and escalation support across the broader enterprise customer base.  
  
Serving as a senior technical escalation point and trusted advisor, this role combines hands-on troubleshooting and advanced API support with cross-functional coordination. The role resolves issues directly when possible, engages the appropriate Engineering, Product, Support, or other technical teams when additional expertise is required, and maintains clear ownership through resolution.  
  
The Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support develops a deep understanding of customer environments, proactively identifies operational risks, and recommends improvements that strengthen reliability, scalability, security, and customer outcomes. This position leads incident communications, service reviews, and post-incident discussions through technical expertise, consultation, and influence rather than direct people management.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

**Customer Escalation, Technical Ownership & Incident Leadership**

* Serve as a senior technical escalation point for CCC’s enterprise customers, with primary day-to-day focus on strategic automotive accounts that have the most complex technical environments and support needs.
* Provide hands-on troubleshooting and advanced API support for complex customer issues, resolving problems directly when possible and engaging the appropriate technical experts when additional support is required.
* Own complex, high-severity customer issues from escalation through resolution by establishing accountability, coordinating resources, and providing timely updates to customer and internal stakeholders.
* Create a direct connection between customer technology teams and CCC’s technical organizations to reduce handoffs, preserve the accuracy of technical information, and prevent critical issues from falling through the cracks.
* Develop a detailed understanding of customer environments, integrations, workflows, and technical dependencies to proactively identify risks and recommend practical improvements.
* Lead technical communications during high-severity incidents, service reviews, and post-incident discussions, translating issues, risks, and resolution plans for audiences ranging from CIOs and senior technology leaders to developers, technical teams, and client help desks.
* Partner across Engineering, Product, Support, Sales, Professional Services, account teams, and applicable third parties to drive resolution and follow through on corrective actions without direct authority.

**Operational Improvement & Strategic Partnership**

* Analyze recurring customer issues, service data, and operational metrics to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities to improve reliability, issue resolution, and the customer experience.
* Translate customer feedback and technical findings into actionable recommendations for product, process, support, documentation, tooling, and automation improvements.
* Contribute to the continued development of escalation models, service-level practices, KPIs, service reporting, and enterprise support processes.
* Build trusted technical relationships with customer technology leaders and serve as a senior advisor on service reliability, operational risk, and complex technical issues.
* Act as a senior subject-matter expert, consultant, and resource for customer technical teams and internal stakeholders.

**Requirements:**
=================

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise technical support, technical account management, service delivery, customer-facing platform support, software development, or a related technical role.
* 3+ years of experience serving as a senior technical escalation resource for large, complex, production environments with high availability and reliability requirements.
* Preferred experience as a Technical Account Manager, senior technical support professional, client-platform liaison, API developer, or similar customer-facing technical expert.

**Technical Depth & Enterprise Support Maturity**

* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and collaborate effectively with development, product, infrastructure, support, or other technical teams.
* Experience supporting APIs, integrations, enterprise platforms, SaaS products, or other interconnected technical environments.
* Preferred working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, distributed systems, databases, or SaaS architectures.
* Preferred experience with incident management, root cause analysis, service-health metrics, SLAs, KPIs, escalation models, or operational-excel

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager (B2B Sales)
jobs.description:
**Build a Career Helping Local Businesses**

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**

**Performance-Based Earnings + Residual Income**

* Commission earned on new accounts
* Residual commissions on existing accounts you continue to manage
* Increased earning potential as you build and grow your client portfolio

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $65,000–$90,000, with top performers earning $125,000+ by consistently exceeding performance goals and growing their book of business.**

* *Additional compensation structures may be available for qualified applicants.*

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Your previous experience gives you a foundation—we’ll help you build on it. You’ll receive **paid, hands-on training** focused on our industry, products, client management process, and approach to growing a book of business.

As you progress, you’ll have access to continued **coaching, mentorship, and professional development** designed to strengthen your skills and prepare you for future opportunities in leadership and business management. Our long-term growth depends on developing talented people who are ready to take on more.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of related sales experience
* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills
* Prior knowledge and experience in the deregulated energy field

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Multiple compensation paths designed to support your career goals
* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

**Career Development**

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors
* Ongoing career coaching
* Advancement opportunities into Management positions

**Additional Benefits**

* Health benefits after eligibility requirements are met
* Team-oriented work environment

At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

You'll bring the right resources in at the right moment in the customer journey so customers reach their evolving business goals. You'll partner closely with a Technical Account Manager (TAM) and the rest of your account pod to design solutions around each customer's challenges.

---------------

### **Retention and risk mitigation**

* Protect and grow long-term revenue by positioning AppFolio as a strategic partner and showing continuous, measurable platform ROI.

* Partner with TAMs to design and implement solutions for specific client challenges.

* Stay current on industry trends and the AppFolio platform, and add to the team's knowledge base.

**How We Define Success**
-------------------------

* Strong gross and net revenue retention across your Strategic portfolio

jobs.description:
**Bilingual Marketing Specialist**

Continental Sales Lots 4 Less • Chicago, Illinois • Full-time

**About Us**
============

Continental Sales Lots 4 Less is a family-owned closeout retailer serving Chicagoland since 1965. We are known for great deals, the excitement of the treasure hunt, and creating a joyful experience for our customers, team members, vendors and community.

**Be the Face of Continental Sales Lots 4 Less!**
=================================================

¿Te encanta conectar con la gente, crear contenido y encontrar grandes ofertas? Love people, social media, great deals, and the energy of a busy store? Continental Sales Lots 4 Less is a family-owned Chicago close-out retailer proudly serving our community since 1965. We believe shopping should feel like a treasure hunt, and that our customers, team members, and community deserve a fun, welcoming, and joyful experience.

We're looking for a bilingual (English/Spanish) Marketing Specialist who wants to be out front, not behind the scenes. As one of the faces of our brand, you'll help bring our personality to life through social media, video content, community events, and in-store engagement. You'll create connections with both our English- and Spanish-speaking customers while helping keep marketing projects organized and moving forward.

If you're comfortable on camera, love interacting with people, and enjoy turning everyday moments into engaging content, this could be the perfect role for you. This is not a behind-the-scenes-only marketing position; it's an opportunity to represent our brand, share our story, and make a real impact in the communities we serve. ¡Ven y crece con nosotros! (Come grow with us!)

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Social Media & Brand Ambassador**
-----------------------------------

* Become a recognizable, friendly on-camera face of CS Lots 4 Less on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other channels.
* Create and capture short-form videos, photos and stories featuring exciting deals, merchandise, customers, team members and store happenings.
* Work with our team and creative partners to plan content, keep posts moving and engage with our community.

**Events & Community - Make Connections**
-----------------------------------------

* Help plan, promote and host fun in-store events and community activities.
* Represent our company at neighborhood events, Chamber gatherings and local business meetings.
* Build relationships with nearby businesses, schools and nonprofits and spot opportunities for partnerships.

**Marketing Coordination - Make It Happen**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain our marketing calendar, organize assets and follow through on deadlines.
* Help execute customer emails, direct mail, loyalty communications and promotions.
* Coordinate with store teams and outside specialists; assist with approved digital campaign tasks when needed.
* Keep basic records and results organized and use modern tools to work efficiently.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You…**
==============================

* Love meeting people and feel natural, confident and enthusiastic on camera.
* Have hands-on experience creating social media content, especially reels or short videos.
* Are creative and energetic but also highly organized and reliable.
* Take initiative, communicate well and enjoy a fast-paced, ever-changing retail setting.
* Can balance being a public-facing brand ambassador with getting administrative work done.

**Experience & Requirements**
=============================

* Bilingual English/Spanish required.
* 3 years + of relevant full-time marketing, social media, communications, events or community experience preferred.
* Experience in retail, hospitality or a community-facing role is a plus; degree helpful but not required.
* Candidates are encouraged to share examples of social media content, short-form videos, or creative campaigns they've personally helped produce.

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* This is a full-time position with an initial 90-day, on-site onboarding period. After 90 days, the position is eligible for a hybrid schedule of three days on-site and two days remote, based on performance and business needs.
* Flexibility is important, as occasional evenings or weekends may be needed for special events and community activities.

**Why Join Us?**
================

You won’t spend every day behind a desk. You’ll help shape how Chicago experiences Continental Sales Lots 4 Less, sharing exciting finds, connecting with neighbors, creating joyful moments and building a marketing function with support from experienced specialists. If you love people, creativity and making things happen, we’d love to meet you.

**Job Description**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager, Thermal Project Management, you will support the Project Manager in leading the team assigned to a thermal power plant. In this position, you will manage multiple workstreams in collaboration with the Project Manager and collaborate with all resources to support the project execution and construction efforts, while coordinating other technical, economic, and commercial aspects of the project.

Being part of the project team assigned to a thermal project, you will interact with specialists to develop, design, and build combustion projects utilizing gas turbines for simple cycles, combined cycles, and cogeneration facilities, as well as natural gas reciprocating engines.

Technical supervision during project execution, specifically construction and commissioning phases, including travel to the project site, will also be required.

This position will be based in the Invenergy office in Chicago, IL.

* Understand project interfaces across multiple contractors and work packages and monitor performance, ensuring adherence to project budget and schedule.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on.

### **About this Role**

Semafor is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented **Contract Audience Coordinator** to support the Audience Development team during a busy period of global events.

This is a hands-on execution role supporting audience acquisition, event communications, RSVP management, and operational coordination. * Provide general administrative and operational support across multiple events.

### **Ideal Experience & Skills**

* Previous experience in event coordination, audience development, marketing operations, or administrative support.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Location: Secaucus, NJ

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Dotted-Line Coordination: Creative Director of Marketing, Brand Editor, and Social Media Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt), overtime-eligible

Compensation: $26–$31 per hour

Artistic Tile is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our Marketing Department while building real event and design skills along the way. This is a high-growth role: reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll get exposure to every part of the department — email, website, product literature, social, PR, and events — and the chance to take on more as you show what you can do.

Your core work is events, followed by design. You'll help plan and run the showroom events and trade shows that put our brand in front of customers and dealers, and you'll use tools like Canva and AI-assisted design to produce the collateral, labels, and presentations that support our sales and marketing efforts.

About Artistic Tile

Artistic Tile is a family-owned and operated luxury tile and stone company—design, import, distribution, and retail under one roof. We're leaders in our field because of the value we place on design innovation, quality control, and customer service. You'll join a marketing team known for producing content that sets the standard for the industry. Our reputation is established; your job is to help create the work and the experiences that uphold it.

What You'll Do

* Event Concept & Production: Help plan and execute showroom events and trade shows, coordinating the invitations, signage, and on-site branding (working with the Creative Director and design team on the look) along with venue selection, catering, rentals, and vendor coordination, for both in-person and virtual events.
* On-Site Event Presence: Represent the brand in person at events, making real-time calls on setup, signage placement, and presentation so the space matches the approved brand look and event plan.
* Design & Collateral Production: Using Canva and AI-assisted design tools, design swatch cards, recess tray labels, product literature layouts, internal presentation templates, social graphics, and other brand collateral — owning each piece from first draft through final, print-ready file. You'll work within the brand templates and standards set by the Creative Director of Marketing, and extend them to new needs.
* AI-Assisted Workflow & Accuracy: Use AI tools to speed up layout, reformatting, and first drafts, and review all output for brand fit and for accuracy against product data (SKUs, dimensions, finish names, ratings) before anything is routed for approval or printed.
* Marketing Department Support: Support the full marketing team day to day, helping the Marketing Manager and teammates across email, website, product literature, social, and PR projects; organizing and distributing promotional materials to showrooms, dealers, and partners; and keeping project tasks and timelines current in Basecamp.
* Brand Stewardship: Work with external vendors and agencies to keep design and messaging consistent and high-quality across every channel.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, product development, and design to keep marketing materials aligned, accurate, and on-brand.

What We're Looking For

* At least 1 year of related experience in event coordination, marketing, or design.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, design, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Experience or strong interest in event logistics and vendor coordination — venues, catering, rentals — and in the on-site energy of a live event.
* Strong time and project management skills, with a knack for prioritizing and hitting deadlines, especially under the pressure of a live event date.
* Fluency in Canva, including building and maintaining templates and brand kits.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude) in design or content work, and the judgment to review their output critically.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can tailor a message clearly for different audiences.
* Comfort working autonomously: you can self-direct your daily tasks and take ownership of a project from concept to completion.
* A collaborative spirit and openness to feedback.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel occasionally and work some evenings/weekends around event dates (all hours worked are paid, with overtime per company policy and applicable law).

Bonus Points

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
* Experience with NetSuite, CRM software, or Basecamp.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing platforms or website content management.

Why You'll Want This Role

* Events with visible impact: You'll help create the showroom events and trade show experiences that customers, designers, and dealers remember — and see how the brand shows up in person.
* Modern tools: We're building our design workflow around Canva and AI-assisted tools, so you'll grow skills that are in demand.
* A high-growth role: This is a launchpad. Demonstrate your skills and there's a clear path to take on greater creative and strategic responsibility as the department grows.
* Exposure to the whole department: Working under the Marketing Manager, you'll see how email, web, print, PR, and events fit together — a fast way to learn the business and find where you want to specialize.
* A great location: A modern headquarters in Secaucus with an easy commute from Manhattan and throughout North New Jersey.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola owns every layer of insurance, from pricing with weather data to paying claims, and thousands of independent agents now trust us to protect their clients' homes. Almost all of those agencies found us through word of mouth, and as we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, the agencies that already sell Sola are the heart of our business. We're looking for an Account Manager who will treat a book of those agencies as their own, help them win more with Sola every month, and show our newer teammates what great partnership looks like.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR**
---------

* **Role:** Account Manager
* **Level:** Mid-level individual contributor, one step above Associate Account Manager
* **Key focus:** Owning and growing a book of independent agency partners
* **Location:** West Midtown, Atlanta, GA

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Account Manager to own a book of active independent agency partners and grow what they write with Sola. The job is to become the person each of your agencies calls first, keep Sola part of their everyday sales conversations, and turn quiet agencies into consistent producers.

You are someone who has already owned a set of accounts or partners on your own, who measures your work by retention and growth, and who enjoys being both a trusted advisor and a problem solver. This is not a traditional service desk role where you wait for tickets, and it is not a hunting role focused on signing new agencies, since our Territory Sales Managers bring partners in and you help them thrive.

You should constantly be:

* Checking in with your agencies by phone, video and in person so they feel confident quoting Sola
* Spotting which agencies are slowing down and acting before they go quiet
* Training agents on our product, tools and process so selling Sola feels easy
* Solving escalations quickly with our underwriting, claims and product teams
* Bringing what you hear from agencies back to the team so we keep improving

You'll work closely with the rest of Account Management, our Territory Sales Managers and our product team, and you'll help build the playbook that the next wave of Associate Account Managers learns from.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* A defined book of active independent agencies and their retention with Sola
* Growth in quotes and policies written across your book
* A regular cadence of check-ins, reviews and agency visits
* Agent training on Sola's product, quoting tools and process
* Fast, complete resolution of agency escalations across teams
* Clean CRM records and a clear view of the health of every account
* Agency feedback shared with product and leadership
* Day-to-day coaching for Associate Account Managers who shadow your work

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

### **Must-haves**

* Experience owning a book of accounts or partners yourself in account management, customer success or a partner-facing role, typically two to four years
* Real results in retaining and growing accounts that you can walk us through with numbers
* A steady, self-driven cadence for check-ins, follow-ups and escalations
* Strong CRM habits and the instinct to use data to decide where to spend your time
* Clear, warm communication with business owners on the phone, in writing and in person
* Curiosity, coachability and low ego, with a habit of asking why
* Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest problem solving and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.

### **Strong plus**

* Experience working with independent insurance agents, brokers or another reseller channel
* Time at an early-stage startup where you helped build the process
* Experience training customers or coaching junior teammates
* Comfort using dashboards, simple analysis or AI tools to manage a book

### **Not a fit**

* You prefer a support role where someone else owns the relationship and the growth goal
* You want a pure new business hunting role
* You need a fully built playbook before you can perform
* You are looking for a remote or hybrid schedule

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Stock options, so you share in what you help build
* 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
* Unlimited PTO
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office
* Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday

**Our Values**
--------------

* **We are a team of owners.** Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.
* **The best idea always wins.** We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.
* **Always raise the bar.** Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.
* **Customer and partner driven.** Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.
* **Results focused.** We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.
* **Ask why, stay curious.** Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

This is a hybrid office environment that meets 3 days a week in our Lawrenceville office.

- Proactively monitor customer health, product usage, and business outcomes to minimize churn risk.
  
- Partner with Support and Technical resources to resolve renewal issues and blockers.
  
  
Growth & Expansion:

Operational Excellence & Insights:

* Educate current and prospective customers on the benefits of natural gas, natural gas appliances, cost savings of converting to natural gas, and answer any questions the customer may have related to any of our growth and retention programs or questions on the process of converting to natural gas

* Support sales management in identifying new customers, markets, and applications for natural gas and assessing the business impact of those implications
* Provide research assistance for strategic planning and business development efforts as well as ad-hoc research requests
* Manage employee and customer referral programs designed to encourage lead generation and topline growth
* Be proficient in several company systems including GSCA, GCMA, CC&B, WMIS, GLOBE and ARM
* Update customer information in GCMA and CC&B, as needed, and serve as research expert on customer accounts
* Responsible for helping lead Records & Information Management (RIM) program for department
* Responsible for special projects, as requested
* Maintains working knowledge of all company products and services, as well as operating policies and procedures
* Other duties as assigned in support of company growth and retention

**Education and Experience:**

**Required:**

BA/BS degree with 2-3 years applicable experience

Or equivalent combination of academic education and experience

**Preferred:**

Natural Gas industry experience with 2-3 years sales, construction, or GIS experience

**Skills:**

**Required:**

* Advanced Microsoft office skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint)
* Must be able to independently set priorities of tasks amongst multiple assigned projects
* Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to work with all levels within the organization
* Ability to effectively sell, listen, and communicate with customers
* Superior organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently

  

**About Southern Company Gas**  
Southern Company Gas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Atlanta-based Southern Company (NYSE:SO), America’s premier energy company. new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

As one of the fastest-growing on-the-go drinkware companies in America, we’ve got a reputation for doing great things. Our vision is simple - bring delight to eating and drinking.

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

We believe the right way to design products starts and ends with two key ingredients: process + people. Process is the path that takes us from ideas to products that are on brand, on time and on budget. People are the secret sauce that adds ingenuity every step of the way.

Together, we navigate each day with optimism, curiosity, a healthy sense of humor and a strong allergy to the word “no.” This desire for better, coupled with a deep understanding of consumers’ daily lives, gets us to meaningful delight.

**About the Role**

The Project Management Coordinator is an entry-level position within the Project Management Office (PMO) primarily responsible for coordinating and overseeing a portfolio of Renovation projects while providing administrative and operational support to the broader PMO team. The Project Management Coordinator will work closely with cross-functional partners to establish project timelines, track deliverables, communicate project status, identify risks or delays, and ensure projects progress according to established deadlines. This position will support key PMO processes and administrative activities as needed. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their project management career who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and interested in developing cross-functional project management experience within a consumer products environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate and manage assigned Renovation projects from initial project intake through completion. These projects will include but are not limited to seasonal retailer endcap or display programs, new inline color refreshes, and/or multipack packaging development.

* Develop and maintain project timelines using SmartSheet, Basecamp, and other PMO tools.

* Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential schedule risks, missing information, or outstanding decisions.
* Escalate issues and missed deadlines to the appropriate project stakeholders and PMO leadership when necessary.

* Manage the administrative intake process for new Renovation projects submitted through the Renovation Intake Form.
* Maintain PMIS trackers and ensure project information remains accurate and current.
* Support the preparation and coordination of quarterly PMO Lessons Learned meetings, including assisting in the preparation, organizing information, documenting key learnings during the meeting, and helping track follow-up actions.
* Assist with other PMO process improvement and administrative initiatives as assigned.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Supply Chain, Marketing, Operations, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 1+ years of professional experience, including internships, project coordination, or other relevant experience.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to proactively follow up with stakeholders and drive tasks toward completion.
* Thrives working in a cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to identify when information, decisions, or deliverables are missing and take appropriate action.
* Logical and creative problem-solving and analytical skills required.
* Possesses influencing skills (leads by example, clearly articulates business cases and interpretation of cause-effect impact).
* Experience with project management tools such as SmartSheet, Basecamp or similar platforms preferred but not required
* Experience working in a consumer products, retail, or customer-focused environment preferred but not required

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as commuter benefits and additional voluntary benefits

Production Artist & Print Project Coordinator

Riverside Graphics and Lowitz + Sons are established Chicago printing companies providing digital printing, commercial printing, design, and print production management services. We handle everything from everyday business printing to more complex publications, marketing materials, and specialty print projects.

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented person with practical layout, typesetting, and prepress skills to support our customer service and production teams.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on position combining basic layout and typesetting, preflight and file preparation, order processing, and print project coordination.

Initially, the role will primarily support our existing customer service representatives and project managers behind the scenes, helping prepare files, process orders, develop estimates, and coordinate production. As you become familiar with our customers and processes, the goal is to take on greater responsibility for managing projects and providing direct customer support.

We're looking for someone who understands how printing works, enjoys solving problems, and is comfortable handling a variety of responsibilities in a small business environment.

Responsibilities

**Graphics & Prepress**

* Prepare, review, and modify customer artwork for print production.
* Create and revise layouts for brochures, booklets, business cards, presentations, and other printed materials.
* Preflight files, identify potential printing issues, and make necessary corrections.
* Prepare print-ready PDFs, proofs, and production files for digital and commercial printing.
* Work with our production team and outside vendors to ensure files are prepared correctly.

**Order Processing & Project Coordination**

* Assist customer service representatives and project managers with preparing estimates, writing orders, and coordinating jobs.
* Review project specifications and identify missing information or potential production issues.
* Request pricing and coordinate production details with outside printing and finishing vendors.
* Track job progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help keep projects moving through production.
* Support both Riverside Graphics' in-house printing operations and Lowitz + Sons' commercial print projects.
* Develop the ability to communicate directly with customers and fully manage assigned projects.

**Production Support**

* When needed, assist the production team with basic hand assembly, finishing, packaging, and shipping.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat.
* Experience preparing artwork and files for commercial printing.
* Working knowledge of bleeds, trim sizes, resolution, color modes, and other print production requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* Comfortable working independently, recognizing problems, and asking questions when needed.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to work collaboratively with customer service, production staff, and outside vendors.

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Previous experience working for a commercial printer, quick-print shop, or print production company.
* Experience with print estimating, job tickets, or print management software.
* Familiarity with digital printing equipment and basic bindery operations.
* Experience communicating with customers or coordinating print projects.

**What We're Looking For**

The right candidate is someone who combines practical design and technical production skills with good organization and follow-through.

We value accuracy, reliability, flexibility, and a willingness to learn. You should enjoy working on a variety of projects and be comfortable in an environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

This is a good opportunity for someone with graphic design or prepress experience who wants to expand into print production coordination and project management.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager (B2B Sales)
new_jobs.description:
**Build a Career Helping Local Businesses**

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**

**Performance-Based Earnings + Residual Income**

* Commission earned on new accounts
* Residual commissions on existing accounts you continue to manage
* Increased earning potential as you build and grow your client portfolio

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $65,000–$90,000, with top performers earning $125,000+ by consistently exceeding performance goals and growing their book of business.**

* *Additional compensation structures may be available for qualified applicants.*

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Your previous experience gives you a foundation—we’ll help you build on it. You’ll receive **paid, hands-on training** focused on our industry, products, client management process, and approach to growing a book of business.

As you progress, you’ll have access to continued **coaching, mentorship, and professional development** designed to strengthen your skills and prepare you for future opportunities in leadership and business management. Our long-term growth depends on developing talented people who are ready to take on more.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of related sales experience
* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills
* Prior knowledge and experience in the deregulated energy field

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Multiple compensation paths designed to support your career goals
* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

**Career Development**

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors
* Ongoing career coaching
* Advancement opportunities into Management positions

**Additional Benefits**

* Health benefits after eligibility requirements are met
* Team-oriented work environment

With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.

Invenergy follows a hybrid schedule, working in office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays if work permits.

**Job Description**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager, Thermal Project Management, you will support the Project Manager in leading the team assigned to a thermal power plant. You will coordinate efforts across multiple teams inside the organization, from development to the commercial operation date (COD). In this position, you will manage multiple workstreams in collaboration with the Project Manager and collaborate with all resources to support the project execution and construction efforts, while coordinating other technical, economic, and commercial aspects of the project.

Being part of the project team assigned to a thermal project, you will interact with specialists to develop, design, and build combustion projects utilizing gas turbines for simple cycles, combined cycles, and cogeneration facilities, as well as natural gas reciprocating engines.
